config.head: mlp_691200
config.claim_scope: Two predetermined validation trajectories per boundary; development pilot only, no final-cohort confirmation.
config.input_output_contract: One host-resident displacement and velocity field, scalar physical wave speed; return displacement and physical velocity on the requested mesh at all 49 observation times, on host. Homogeneous unforced equation.
config.force_scale: initial displacement mass-L2 norm / horizon squared
config.affine_forcing: Retained exactly, including nonzero offset. Supplied speed enters timed setup and propagation.
config.full_field_audit: All full-grid same-grid references and learned bank tables plus every first-repetition ROM coefficient state saved; common-grid outputs retained for every method. Repetition hashes retained.

training.construction: Unnormalized training displacement coefficients, centered SVD and population-standard-deviation scaling, original convention.
Unnormalized training displacement coefficients, centered SVD and population-standard-deviation scaling, original convention.

interpretation: Two development cases per boundary. Raw paired ratios are not equal-accuracy certification. Linear controls live in the frozen learned bank and are not claims about unchanged MLP performance.
